label: Daehan 2D Keyframe Review V1
description: 2D 대한 캐릭터 기반으로 clean base와 keyframe을 먼저 승인받은 뒤, 씬별 시작/종료 프레임과 boundary mode를 이용해 6초 영상 클립을 순차 생성하는 실험 포맷.

sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneStartRule: each scene declares an approved start frame; continuous_handoff scenes use the prior clip final frame as the next start seed, while transition_cut scenes use their own approved start frame
sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneBoundaryRule: each boundary declares boundaryMode. Use continuous_handoff for uninterrupted action continuity. Use transition_cut for intentional time, angle, scale, location, or emotional beat changes.
sceneGenerationPolicy.sceneFrameRule: each scene should lock both a start frame and an end frame before motion generation
sceneGenerationPolicy.scenePoseTargetRule: approved keyframes define the target pose and expression for each scene block
